chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Al-Husayn ibn Khalid from Abu Al-Hasan the Second (peace be upon him) who said:

I said to him, 'We have been narrated in the hadith that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would clean himself (with stones/water) and his ring was on his finger, and similarly the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) did that. And the engraving of the ring of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was: Muhammad (peace be upon him) the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).' He (peace be upon him) said, 'They spoke the truth.' I said, 'So should we do it?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Indeed, those people were wearing their rings on the right hand, and indeed you are wearing your rings on the left hand.'

He (the narrator) said, 'So I was silent, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Do you know what was the engraving of the ring of Adam (peace be upon him)?' I said, 'No.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.' And the engraving of the ring of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was: Muhammad the Messenger of Allah; and the ring of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was: Allah the King; and the ring of Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) was: The Honour is for Allah; and the ring of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was: Indeed Allah will fulfill His command; and Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) [wore] the ring of his father; and Abu Ja'far al-Akbar [wore] the ring of his grandfather Al-Husayn (peace be upon him); and the ring of Ja'far (peace be upon him) was: Allah is my Guardian and my protection from His creation; and Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him) [wore]: Allah is Sufficient for me; and Abu Al-Hasan al-Thani (peace be upon him) [wore]: Whatever Allah willed, there is no strength except with Allah.'
And Al-Husayn ibn Khalid said, 'And he extended his hand to me and said: 'My ring is also the ring of my father (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.خَاتَم: Ring (used for sealing documents or as jewelry)
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِي: To clean oneself (after relieving oneself) using stones or water

ai.seo_question: What were the inscriptions on the rings of the Prophet and the Imams according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the evolution of the custom of wearing rings, noting the transition from the right hand (as practiced by the Prophet and early Imams) to the left hand in later traditions, while affirming the spiritual significance of the inscriptions. It provides a detailed genealogy of the specific divine names and phrases engraved on the rings of the Twelve Imams, linking their authority directly to the Prophet's legacy. This serves as both a practical guideline for ritual purity practices and a theological affirmation of the Imams' unique status.

en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We are reporting in the Hadeeth that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was cleaning himself<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> ring was in his<sup>saww</sup> finger, and similar to that is what Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> did, and the engraving of a ring of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was – “Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup>”’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They spoke the truth’. I said, ‘So would it befit us that we do it’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They (people) are wearing rings in the right hand and you all are wearing rings in the left hand’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So I was silent, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do you know what was the engraving in the ring of Adam<sup>as</sup>?’ So I said, ‘No’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no god except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’, and the engraving in the ring of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> was “Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>”; and the ring of Amir Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the King”; and the ring of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> was “The Honour is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>”, and the ring of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Fulfils His<sup>azwj</sup> Command”, and Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> wore the ring of his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the great wore the ring of his<sup>asws</sup> grandfather Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and the ring of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> was “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is my<sup>asws</sup> Guardian and Protects me<sup>asws</sup> from His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures; and Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup> “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Sufficient”; and Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup> “Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires, there is no Strength except with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>”’.

And Al-Husayn Bin Khalid (the narrator) said, ‘And he<sup>asws</sup> extended his<sup>asws</sup> hand towards me and said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> ring is the ring of my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> as well’.
en.sarwar: 8. Sahl ibn Ziyad Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Khalid who has said the following:

“I once said to abu al-Hassan, al-Thaniy, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘We narrate in Hadith that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, after using the rest room performed cleansing while wearing his ring on his finger and so also did ’Amir al-Mu’minin. The engraving on the ring of the Messenger of Allah said, ‘Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah’. He (the Imam) said, ‘They have spoken the truth.’ I then asked, ‘Is it proper for us to do so?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘They wore the ring on their right hand and you wear it on your left hand.’

I then remained quiet and he (the Imam) asked, ‘Do you know what the engraving on the ring of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam was?’ I replied, ‘No, I do not know.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It was ‘No one deserves worship except Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.’ The engraving on the ring of the last and seal of the prophets said, ‘Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah’. The engraving on the ring of ’Amir al-Mu’minin said, ‘Allah is the owner. ’ On the ring of al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it said, ‘All glory belongs to Allah.’ On the ring of al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it said, ‘Allah achieves His goals.’ On the ring of Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, it was like the ring of his father. On the ring of abu Ja‘far, the great, it was like the ring of his grandfather. On the ring of Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it said, ‘Allah is my Guardian and protector from His creatures. ’ On the ring of abu al- Hassan, al-Awwal, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it said, ‘Allah is sufficient for me.’ On the ring of abu al-Hassan, al-Thaniy, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it said, ‘It is all what Allah wants, there is no power except Allah.’

Al- Husayn ibn Khalid has said that he (the Imam) then extended his hand to me and said, ‘The engraving on my ring is like the engraving on the ring of my father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam.’” (Abu al-Hassan, al- Thaniy, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it seems had two rings. One was his own ring with engraving that said, ‘It is all what Allah wants, there is no power except Allah’ and his other ring was the ring of his father).
